_comment: Copy to uat.settings.json and prod.settings.json (both git-ignored). Values come from D:/SmartMoney-Secrets/connections-ENV.txt written by provision.ps1. Keys starting with _ are skipped by deploy-api.ps1.
Seed__SuperAdminEmail: <the client's admin email; register it in the app, then restart once>
Webhooks__CuelinksToken: <a new random token, also set in the Cuelinks postback URL>
AffiliateNetworks__Cuelinks__ApiKey: <Cuelinks V3 API key with the write:links scope; until set, the test client is used and no commission is earned>
AffiliateNetworks__Cuelinks__ChannelId: <Cuelinks channel ID of the SmartMoney app; optional>
